errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars are arranged in random order ('произволен ред'), when they are clearly sorted in ascending order of value from left to right (10.8%, 15.8%, 31.7%).

The description claims the vertical axis is 'labeled with percentages' ('етикетирана с проценти'). However, the y-axis labels are numbers (0, 5, 10, etc.), and there is no axis title. The percentage symbol (%) only appears on the data labels above each bar.
